where: crates/blaze-cli/src/engine_times.rs Times::fold (a row's wall is first start to last end of the intervals filed in it); engine_scripts.rs Pipeline::collect files tasks by (wave, name) order, not by when they ran
what: tempo's profile showed 'Names 7' with a wall of about 41.7 s for 3 tasks of a few ms each, which read as a phase waiting 41 s. It was not waiting: its three tasks ran about 41.7 s apart and were filed into one row because they share a phase, so the row's wall is the cover of their intervals, mostly other rows' work.
cost: about an hour reading the pipeline before the profile could be trusted
cause: a pipelined phase's row has no wall of its own; the fold gave it the span of whatever was filed in it
whys: PhaseTime was designed for phases run whole, one after another; the pipeline made rows overlap and nothing said what a row's wall was made of
class: a time printed as a stage's that is a cover of others' work: any total with no account of its parts
prevention: done in D167 (b): each Names/Scripts row and stage now reads wall = its tasks + other tasks + coordinator stretches + unaccounted, with an UNACCOUNTED line over 1% (engine_times.rs Account)
annoyance: a row named by its phase reads as a phase that ran for its wall
workaround: read the row's account line, not its wall
